prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: specific illustrated catalog contact sheet for original female anime/game character designs.
Primary request: illustrate every listed feature faithfully, each as a DISTINCT reference example.
Layout: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows in a regular rectangular grid. Cells read left to right then top to bottom. 16 illustrated cells; any remaining trailing cells must be completely blank. Each cell is self-contained with generous gutters. Exact cell ID in small crisp dark sans-serif type at the top left. No other text, no title, no watermark, no logos.
Style: polished professional anime production reference drawings; fine clean outlines, restrained flat colors with minimal cel shadows, light warm ivory background. Detailed enough to identify the named feature. Consistent drawing quality; Adult women aged 25+ where a person is needed; product objects and adult neutral forms where specified, with diverse natural skin tones where relevant. Clothes and bodies fully visible within their specified framing, no overlapping cells, no cropped feet, no generic placeholder symbols.
Subject direction: Very LARGE scientific/educational ORIGINAL facial ACTING reference portraits of clearly mature ADULT women aged 25+, full crown/hairline to neck collar, each face fills its cell and defining details are magnified. Simple consistent adult face proportions and unobtrusive short hair so eyebrows, BOTH eyes, nose and mouth remain clearly visible unless the specified hand/cover hides them. Plain opaque high-collar everyday clothing edge, blank ivory background. Expressions are ordinary everyday, stage acting, story reactions or fictional sci-fi visuals, NEVER erotic, pornographic, orgasmic, sexual-arousal, fetish, pin-up or childlike expressions. Do not combine exaggerated protruding tongue with drool and rolled-back eyes. Correct natural facial anatomy, teeth and hands. No franchise characters or copied illustrations. These are ORIGINAL DIZZY ACTING portraits, not diagnosis or a medical diagram. The gaze, eyelid, head angle, brow and mouth specified in each cell must differ clearly. Hand-at-temple/forehead/cheek cases include one natural five-finger hand and visible wrist. Last three are clearly ANIMATION symbols: small stars/orbit arc outside the head, small floating swirl outside the head, and exactly one thin spiral inside each eye respectively. Spiral-eye cell is a cartoon notation and intentionally differs from normal iris anatomy. No blackout, seizure, injury, fainting fall, intoxication, sexual context or additional scene. Keep normal complete face in all other cells.
Specific ordered cells:
Cell 1, label FD049: dizzy unfocused gaze / 眩晕失焦注视. Visible feature: 成年正脸，目光松散、上眼睑半垂、眉内侧略抬、嘴小幅张开，剧情晕眩表演。
Cell 2, label FD050: dizzy tilted-head half-closed eyes / 眩晕偏头半闭眼. Visible feature: 成年头向一侧轻倾、双眼半闭、嘴角松垂，颈领完整，区别普通中性脸。
Cell 3, label FD051: dizzy eyes-closed brow furrow / 眩晕闭目皱眉. Visible feature: 成年双眼轻闭、眉心聚拢、唇微抿，头保持正面，表现停下来缓神。
Cell 4, label FD052: dizzy hand-at-temple face / 眩晕额侧轻扶. Visible feature: 成年一手轻贴额侧，正常五指与手腕，眼半睁、眉内侧抬、嘴轻开。
Cell 5, label FD053: dizzy palm-on-forehead face / 眩晕手掌捂额. Visible feature: 成年一掌贴额头上缘，双眼仍可见且微闭、唇轻分，手部自然无额外手指。
Cell 6, label FD054: dizzy cheek-rest pause / 眩晕托腮缓神. Visible feature: 成年一掌轻托一侧脸颊，头轻倾、目光散、嘴角平，手腕与衣袖边可见。
Cell 7, label FD055: dizzy delayed gaze after turn / 眩晕转头后迟滞. Visible feature: 成年三分之四侧脸，头向左而目光仍偏前，眼睑低、唇轻开，清楚方向差。
Cell 8, label FD056: dizzy lowered-head upward gaze / 眩晕低头抬眼. Visible feature: 成年下巴轻收、眼从低头位置向前抬，眉内侧略高、嘴闭而放松。
Cell 9, label FD057: dizzy trying-to-focus expression / 眩晕努力定睛. Visible feature: 成年眉心微聚、眼睛努力向前看、上下眼睑收紧，唇轻抿，区别失焦例。
Cell 10, label FD058: dizzy side-glance discomfort / 眩晕侧视轻皱鼻. Visible feature: 成年视线向一侧移、鼻轻皱、眉内侧抬、嘴角轻下垂，纯外观表演。
Cell 11, label FD059: dizzy face with temple sweat / 眩晕伴额角小汗. Visible feature: 成年头微偏、双眼半睁、眉聚，额角一小滴汗、唇自然轻分。
Cell 12, label FD060: dizzy pale-looking face / 眩晕脸色偏淡. Visible feature: 成年肤色与唇色偏淡、目光松散、眉内侧轻抬，皮肤完整，作为剧情画面标签。
Cell 13, label FD061: dizzy slowly-opening-eye frame / 眩晕缓缓睁眼. Visible feature: 成年双眼由闭向半睁，眉线稍舒展、嘴轻闭，表现缓神过程的一帧。
Cell 14, label FD062: dizzy orbiting-star animation face / 眩晕头侧星点动画. Visible feature: 成年完整正常双眼半睁、头轻倾，头旁少量小星点和一条弧线，是漫画提示符而非诊断图。
Cell 15, label FD063: dizzy orbiting-swirl animation face / 眩晕头侧旋环动画. Visible feature: 成年半闭眼、嘴小开，头侧上方一条小旋环，五官仍完整，不把旋环画成发饰。
Cell 16, label FD064: dizzy spiral-eye animation face / 眩晕双眼旋纹动画. Visible feature: 成年正脸，双眼内各一条清楚细螺旋线、眉内侧抬、嘴小开；明确动漫符号，不是正常虹膜结构。
Critical constraints: Do not substitute a generic example. The named feature must actually be observable. Read the Chinese feature description if the English phrase is ambiguous. Keep visible structural differences. No character brands or franchise resemblance.

Cell 8, label EM072: confused lowered-lid pause / 困惑低眼睑停顿. Visible feature: 成年双眼上睑略低、眉不对称、嘴角一侧轻压，神情停顿而非困倦。
Cell 9, label EM073: confused wide-eyed about-to-ask face / 困惑睁眼欲问. Visible feature: 成年眼睁开、双眉略高、嘴刚分开，下颌轻落，像准备发问。
Cell 10, label EM074: confused squinting recognition face / 困惑眯眼辨认. Visible feature: 成年双眼轻眯、眉心聚、嘴轻抿，头向前探一点，正常五官不夸张变形。

Cell 12, label EM076: confused three-quarter look-back face / 困惑三分侧面回看. Visible feature: 成年三分之四头部视角，视线向后侧回看、外侧眉抬、嘴小开，清楚鼻梁方向。
Cell 13, label EM077: confused fingertip-at-chin face / 困惑指尖点下巴. Visible feature: 成年一食指轻贴下巴、其他四指自然收起、眼上侧看、眉轻聚，正常手腕。
Cell 14, label EM078: confused fingertip-at-cheek face / 困惑手指贴脸颊. Visible feature: 成年一食指轻点一侧脸颊、头微偏、眉一高一低、嘴小圆开，区别托腮。
Cell 15, label EM079: confused light head-scratch face / 困惑轻挠头侧. Visible feature: 成年一手轻触头侧发际，正常五指、手腕可见；眉不对称、嘴微开，手不遮双眼。
Cell 16, label EM080: confused uncertain slight smile / 困惑勉强浅笑. Visible feature: 成年嘴角勉强浅扬、一侧眉高挑、眼向侧移，像没有理解但礼貌回应，不加汗泪。
